text.title: 展屏上的卵
text.situation:
下雨让大家进入野生动物展室。照片里的蜥蜴一动不动，旁边是鳄鱼模型。两者标着爬行动物；都不是在保护区里游荡的活体。屏幕上卵开始孵化，小头从壳里露出。露丝把影片停在季节表，显示这个物种何时交配。玛雅回望鳄鱼模型，注意到它的颚与蜥蜴差别很大。

乔：所有爬行动物都产卵吗？
露丝：不是。影片展示一个物种，并非所有爬行动物的统一规则。
玛雅：小动物自己从卵中孵出吗？
露丝：看看下一帧壳怎样动。

paragraphs.en: Rain drove the group into the wildlife exhibition room. A lizard lay motionless in a photograph beside a model crocodile. Both were labelled as reptiles; neither animal was roaming the reserve. On the screen, eggs began to hatch, and a small head appeared through a shell. Ruth paused the film at a seasonal chart showing when this species would mate. Maya looked back at the crocodile model and noticed how different its jaw was from the lizard’s.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Does every reptile lay eggs?
Ruth: No. This film shows one species, not a rule for every reptile.
Maya: Did that young animal hatch by itself?
Ruth: Watch the shell move in the next frame.
